winning_headline: Code All Night Without the Eye Strain
winning_copy: Meet the LuminaDesk Smart Lamp, engineered with zero-flicker eye-care LEDs and auto-dimming sensors to keep your late-night study sessions comfortable. Plus, the built-in wireless charger keeps your phone powered up while you crush your deadlines.
reason_for_selection: Variant 1 follows all brand guidelines. It avoids unsubstantiated superlatives, focuses on tangible features like zero-flicker LEDs and wireless charging, maintains a warm and empathetic tone, and includes a polite, action-oriented prompt implied in its concluding benefit.
rejected_variants_notes: Variant 2 violates Rule 1 by using the unsubstantiated superlative 'ultimate'. Variant 3 also violates Rule 1 by using the superlative 'ultimate' twice ('ultimate productivity upgrade'). Both were rejected due to this strict compliance failure.
